t: How the Acronym Expansion Engine works (Signature)
title: How the Acronym Expansion Engine works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Acronym Expansion Engine does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature engine builds a definition ledger: every acronym-expansion pair is stored with its source sentence, its pattern type (forward or reverse definition), and a deterministic confidence weight from pattern strength and corroboration count. Expansion at query time consults the ledger with fixed scoring weights, so the same document always yields the same expansions. Document-local definitions outrank global candidates by rule, which mirrors how human readers actually work. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
